hoist.label: Trace drum rotation to a suspended load
hoist.observed: Official winding questions connect a driven rim to a load; the takeoff side sets the linear direction.
hoist.construct: Author a native system with external mesh, keyed drum and taut cord. State the frame and compare the opposite takeoff. Record joint as cord:<drum>/<load> using the actual body IDs.
hoist.extension: The formal FreeCAD gear-driven hoist is a harness assembly inspired by the original winding relation.

slide.label: Infer the guided slide velocity
slide.observed: A captured crank pin transmits the velocity component across the slot; the guide fixes the output axis.
slide.construct: Give a nondegenerate crank phase, drive and observer. A foil follows the free component along the slot. Release the named shaft key and test whether the same slide motion is forced. Use key:<wheel>/<crank>.
slide.extension: The native FreeCAD worksheet asks about an instant in the guided stroke.

orbit.label: Separate planet spin and axle orbit
orbit.observed: The relative mesh velocity on the carrier and the grounded sun constrain spin in the observer frame.
orbit.construct: Connect a fixed sun and moving pinion, mark the carrier input and both outputs. A foil transfers the carrier sign to both. Release the sun constraint and compare allowed outcomes. Use ground:<sun>.
orbit.extension: The harness builds and measures the native assembly in FreeCAD.
